CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.craft_equipment_recipe(p_player_id uuid, p_recipe_id text, p_money_cost double precision, p_reward_id text, p_reward_name text, p_reward_category text, p_reward_tier integer, p_luck_bonus double precision, p_roll_speed_bonus double precision, p_weight_luck_bonus double precision, p_weight_multiplier_bonus double precision, p_required_equipment_id text)
 RETURNS jsonb
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO ''
AS $function$
declare
  v_money double precision;
  v_new_money double precision;
begin

  select money
  into v_money
  from public.players
  where id = p_player_id
  for update;

  if not found then
    raise exception 'player_not_found';
  end if;

  if v_money < p_money_cost then
    raise exception 'not_enough_money';
  end if;


  -- Remove prerequisite equipment if recipe has one.
  if p_required_equipment_id is not null then
    delete from public.player_equipment
    where
      player_id = p_player_id
      and equipment_id = p_required_equipment_id;
  end if;


  -- Add / replace crafted equipment.
  insert into public.player_equipment (
    player_id,
    equipment_id,
    category,
    tier,
    name,
    luck_bonus,
    roll_speed_bonus,
    weight_luck_bonus,
    weight_multiplier_bonus,
    equipped
  )
  values (
    p_player_id,
    p_reward_id,
    p_reward_category,
    p_reward_tier,
    p_reward_name,
    p_luck_bonus,
    p_roll_speed_bonus,
    p_weight_luck_bonus,
    p_weight_multiplier_bonus,
    true
  )
  on conflict (
    player_id,
    equipment_id
  )
  do update set
    category = excluded.category,
    tier = excluded.tier,
    name = excluded.name,
    luck_bonus = excluded.luck_bonus,
    roll_speed_bonus = excluded.roll_speed_bonus,
    weight_luck_bonus = excluded.weight_luck_bonus,
    weight_multiplier_bonus = excluded.weight_multiplier_bonus,
    equipped = true;


  update public.players
  set money =
    money - p_money_cost
  where id =
    p_player_id
  returning money
  into v_new_money;


  delete from public.crafting_progress
  where
    player_id = p_player_id
    and recipe_id = p_recipe_id;


  update public.player_crafting
  set
    active_auto_craft =
      case
        when active_auto_craft = p_recipe_id
        then null
        else active_auto_craft
      end,

    updated_at = now()

  where player_id =
    p_player_id;


  return jsonb_build_object(
    'money',
    v_new_money,
    'equipmentId',
    p_reward_id
  );

end;
$function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.equipment_gem_sell_multiplier(p_player_id uuid)
 RETURNS numeric
 LANGUAGE sql
 STABLE SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO ''
AS $function$
 select
  case when exists(select 1 from public.player_equipment e where e.player_id=p.id and e.equipment_id='supersizer-pickaxe' and e.equipped)
   then 1.25 * case when nullif(p.equipment_state->>'supersizerBlessingUntil','')::timestamptz>now() then 1.5 else 1 end
   else 1 end
  * case when public.player_has_mine_artifact(p.id,'foreman-seal') then 1.03 else 1 end
 from public.players p where p.id=p_player_id
$function$
